title: Frontend: Confetti Animation
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Confetti Animation. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({count=8,reducedMotion=false}). Celebrate displays count decorative particle spans [data-particle] unless reducedMotion, when none appear. Show Celebration complete in a status region. Clear removes particles/status. Count is valid 0..20. Keep animations transform/opacity based.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Create a finite particle set at the celebration boundary and animate transforms/opacity rather than layout properties.
alternativeApproaches: Move a larger particle simulation to canvas while bounding frame work and lifetime.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Repeated trigger; unmount; zero particles.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
